The generated gh-aw setup action installs support scripts but is not itself an AI agent execution.
A provider name passed as an argument to a validator is data, not a Copilot CLI invocation.
A path-qualified Copilot executable is an agent invocation and receives a repository secret.
The finding must point to the action step rather than an earlier comment containing the same action reference.
